name: Shenzhoupterus
isnote: Also recovered within Tapejaridae (Chaoyangopterinae) by Pinheiro et al. (2011).
sum: Toothless chaoyangopterid with a crest arching over the eyes, from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: HGM 41HIII-305A (Henan Geological Museum) — Jiufotang Formation, Liaoning.
material: Articulated skull and skeleton of one individual.
biology: A small toothless azhdarchoid, probably a ground forager.
author: Lü et al. 2008

species.name: Shenzhoupterus chaoyangensis
species.author: Lü et al. 2008
species.ref: J. Lü, D. M. Unwin, and L. Xu, X. Zhang. 2008. A new azhdarchoid pterosaur from the Lower Cretaceous of China and its implications for pterosaur phylogeny and evolution. Naturwissenschften 95:891-897
